# ufoo 4.0.3

This patch makes the `ufoo mcp` stdio proxy speak the standard MCP framing used
by Cursor, while keeping newline JSON for existing clients.

## Fixes

- Accept `Content-Length` stdio frames, including headers and bodies split
  across reads, and reply with the same framing. Cursor can use `ufoo mcp`
  without an external adapter.
- Keep newline-delimited JSON as the response framing until a client sends a
  `Content-Length` frame.

## Validation

- `npm test -- --runTestsByPath test/unit/daemon/mcpStdioProxy.test.js test/unit/daemon/mcpTransportIntegration.test.js`
- Codex App keeps its existing Streamable HTTP configuration. After the daemon
  restarts on this version, initialize, tool listing, and `ufoo_mcp_status`
  succeed against that same loopback listener.
